integrity.claims_not_made: No full two-dimensional global entropy, all-attractor census, or period characterization beyond specified wave subset.
integrity.finite_script: verify_cca_waves.py; standard-library integer tests for matrix characteristic polynomials and direct 2D updates

scientific_limitations: Only complete one-index traveling wave subsets of two stripe orientations are classified, not arbitrary full-lattice automaton orbits.
Topological entropy is restricted to the indicated compact one-dimensional stripe subsystems; it is not the entropy of the entire two-dimensional cellular automaton.
All thresholds are integers 1 through 8 and the Moore neighborhood consists of eight distinct neighbor offsets.
The older general traveling-state transducer construction may yield these exact numbers through specialized application; no exhaustive worldwide priority certification is claimed.
title: Orientation-selected entropy and exact stripe-wave counts in a three-color cyclic automaton
